name: Mahiru ni Odoru Hanzaisha
source:
When you need "Anything" done, you can turn on our protagonist and his three companions.
"Anything" goes from babysitting to investigation of extramarital affairs, even criminal acts such as kidnapping or robbery. Whatever it is, it will be done, as long as there's enough compensation.

Of course there's a downside to this business. Everywhere you look, danger lurks in every corner. While he didn't want to see it, the protagonist saw the dark side of a corporate giant. And thus begins our protagonist's fight...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=7320]Getchu[/url]]

Metropolis Crime Simulation game from Softhouse Chara.
Hire troops, find missions and complete it. Will the protagonist make it out alive?
translation:
無論需要完成「任何事情」，你都可以委託主角與他的三名同伴。
所謂「任何事情」，既包括照顧孩子和調查婚外情，也包括綁架、搶劫等犯罪行為。只要報酬足夠，無論任務是什麼，他們都會完成。

當然，這門生意也有缺點：無論望向何處，危險都潛伏在每個角落。主角本不想看見，卻無意間目睹某家大企業的黑暗面。於是，他的戰鬥開始了……

[翻譯自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=7320]Getchu[/url]]

Softhouse Chara製作的都市犯罪模擬遊戲。
僱用部隊、接下並完成各種任務。主角能活著走到最後嗎？
